# bvento

> bvento is a retailer of Italian-made leather and suede handbags in Bentonville, Arkansas (Northwest Arkansas). A small, hand-picked selection, each bag inspected by hand. Viewings by appointment; call or text 479-485-3374.

- Phone (call or text): +1 479-485-3374
- Location: Bentonville, Arkansas, USA (viewings by appointment; serves Bentonville, Rogers, Springdale, Fayetteville)
- Website: https://bvento.com/
